items.title: Unlock with your PIN even on weak network
items.description: A correct PIN now opens the app with low or no internet. Open the app online once after updating so your device can remember it.

items.title: Chart point no longer hidden
items.description: On the Net worth chart, the highlighted point stays visible while you press or slide along the line — the value box now sits beside it instead of on top.

items.title: Fresh index strip every trading morning
items.description: NIFTY, SENSEX and BANKNIFTY reset to 0 at 4:30 AM on market days and go live again when the market opens at 9:15 AM. Weekends and holidays keep the last close.

items.title: Tidier Today's market cards
items.description: The three index cards in Notifications now line up evenly across the panel instead of spilling off the edge.
